concerns.text: T014a (create edge_cases.py) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but T014b and T014c explicitly depend on T014a's file creation. T014a must complete before T014b/c can run. Marking T014a as [P] implies it has no dependencies, which is false if T014b/c are considered part of the same parallel group, or T014b/c must be removed from the [P] group. The 'Foundational' phase claims tasks are sequential, yet T014a is tagged [P] while T014b/c depend on it, creating a semantic contradiction in the parallel safety claim.

T013d (result aggregation) is marked [P] but depends on T013a (main.py orchestration) which writes the raw data. T013d cannot run in parallel with T013a; it must wait for T013a to complete the write. The [P] tag is incorrect here as it implies no ordering dependency on the producer task.

T022 (extend coverage_results.csv) depends on T013d (aggregation) and T021b (integration). T022 is marked [P] but cannot run until T013d and T021b are complete. The [P] tag is invalid as it ignores the producer-consumer dependency on the CSV file structure.

T026 (GLM analysis) depends on T013d (aggregation). T026 is marked [P] but cannot run until T013d produces the `artifacts/coverage_results.csv`. The [P] tag is incorrect as it implies independence from the data producer.
T031 (sensitivity analysis) depends on T013d. T031 is marked [P] but requires the output of T013d. The [P] tag is invalid.

T038 (refactor synthetic_pop.py) and T039 (download_utils.py) are marked [P] but T038 explicitly depends on the existence of `code/data/synthetic_pop.py` which is created in T003. If T003 is not complete, T038 cannot run. While T003 is in Phase 2, the [P] tag on T038 implies it has no dependencies, which is false if T003 is not yet done. More critically, T038 depends on the *content* of T003 (the file structure), making it not truly parallel-safe with respect to the foundational phase completion.
